primary_issue.title: Residential vs Commercial Classification
primary_issue.question: Whether hostels occupied by working men and women should be classified as residential premises or commercial premises for municipal taxation, water charges and allied levies.

secondary_issues.title: Maintainability
secondary_issues.question: Whether writ petitions are maintainable despite the availability of an alternate statutory appeal.

secondary_issues.title: Natural Justice
secondary_issues.question: Whether tariff conversion without prior notice violates principles of natural justice.

secondary_issues.title: Recipient Perspective
secondary_issues.question: Should the nature of the premises be determined from the owner's business or the occupant's use?

secondary_issues.title: Beneficial Interpretation
secondary_issues.question: Whether exemption provisions should receive purposive and beneficial interpretation.

thinkingos_summary.observation: Residents use hostels exactly like homes.
thinkingos_summary.communication: If people live there, the law should evaluate the premises as a residence unless legislation clearly requires otherwise.
